name: Sola to Hato.
source:
When Sōji entered university, the part-time job he chose led him to meet a young lady who lived alone.
She introduced herself as a first-year student at the same university as Sōji.
[Translated from Official Site]
translation:
当宗司进入大学时，他选择的兼职工作让他认识了一位独居的年轻女士。
她介绍自己是与宗司同一所大学的一年级学生。
[译自官方网站]
